entries.back_en: Yes! This old dog still has a good nose. How do you think I got through all that venom?
entries.note: Accurate; 'got around' rendered as 'passar por' which fits context.

entries.back_en: Of course I'm not talking to myself. I'm talking to you, tin man. You know? I've stopped being surprised at you showing up around. You have the same adventurous spirit I had at your age. Well... and at mine too.
entries.note: Faithful; minor natural additions preserve meaning.
